scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @kooyaph/ui build && corepack pnpm --filter @kooyaph/ui-playground build
scripts.dev: corepack pnpm --filter @kooyaph/ui build && corepack pnpm --filter @kooyaph/ui-playground dev
scripts.format: prettier --write packages/ui/src apps/playground/src docs README.md AGENTS.md
scripts.storybook: corepack pnpm --filter @kooyaph/ui build && corepack pnpm --filter @kooyaph/ui-storybook dev
scripts.release: corepack pnpm --filter @kooyaph/ui build && corepack pnpm exec changeset publish
scripts.validate: corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build:storybook
